items.text: His campaign says he is an investor with more than two decades of private equity and venture capital experience. He is the president and CEO of Frontload Group LLC and a board member of the Lupus Society of Illinois. He previously worked at Atlas Capital Markets, Arlington Capital Management, Wells Fargo Advisors, and Bank of America. He holds a master's degree in political science and a bachelor's degree in economics and statistics from Northwestern University.

items.text: He supports a full-scale review of the state budget to reduce wasteful spending. He wants to strengthen public safety and improve infrastructure. He aims to lower the cost of essentials like food, medicine, transportation, and property taxes. He supports working across party lines.
